title: The US, China, and other APEC economies release a statement supporting open models, while emphasizing respect for security, data protection, and IP rights (Evelyn Cheng/CNBC)
summary: Evelyn Cheng / CNBC: The US, China, and other APEC economies release a statement supporting open models, while emphasizing respect for security, data protection, and IP rights — CHENGDU, China — Governments increasingly want to control artificial intelligence, as companies release more powerful open-source models, a new multilateral statement indicates.
